title: Wire up or delete the 4 unused core/domain/value_objects/ types (Pin, StageOrder, ScopeLevel/ScopeValue/CurriculumScope, CalendarSystem)

evidence.quote: class CurriculumScope extends DataClass implements Insertable<CurriculumScope> {

why: A repo-wide grep for constructor/import usage of Pin, StageOrder, ScopeLevel, ScopeValue, CurriculumScope (the domain VO), and CalendarSystem finds zero call sites in lib/ outside their own files — each is exercised only by its own unit test. This isn't a harmless unused-import: it has a concrete duplication cost (set_parent_pin_use_case.dart independently hand-rolls the exact same `^\d{4}$` regex Pin.parse already implements, so the 4-digit PIN invariant now has two unlinked sources of truth) and a naming-collision cost (the domain `CurriculumScope` in scope.dart and the Drift-generated row class `CurriculumScope` in user_database.g.dart are two unrelated types with the identical name, which is exactly what would happen if the intended repository→domain mapping was never implemented). Each of these 4 files also drags a full unit-test file along for code that provides zero runtime value today, inflating the maintenance surface with no compensating benefit.
recommendation: For each: either finish the primitive-obsession migration the docstrings reference (route set_parent_pin_use_case.dart through Pin, route curriculum_scope_dao.dart mapping through ScopeLevel/ScopeValue/CurriculumScope, adopt StageOrder/CalendarSystem at their intended call sites) or delete the type and its test if there is no near-term plan to adopt it.
acceptance_criteria: For each of Pin/StageOrder/ScopeLevel-ScopeValue-CurriculumScope/CalendarSystem: at least one production (non-test) import exists, or the file + its test are removed.
set_parent_pin_use_case.dart's hand-rolled `_isNumeric` regex is replaced by (or asserted equivalent to) Pin.parse's validation once a decision is made.
No two public top-level classes in lib/ share the name CurriculumScope (AG-4).

corrections: SetParentPinUseCase (not just Pin) is unreferenced anywhere in lib/ or test/ — fully dead, so the cited duplication pairing has no live exposure; the real live duplicate is pin_service.dart:261 _isNumeric (RegExp ^\d+$, distinct from Pin.parse's ^\d{4}$).
